programme.title: Coureurs de bois

programme.title: César Wagner

programme.title: Les recrues de la 15e

programme.title: Les recrues de la 15e
programme.desc: Franck Best est destitué, et Jarvis nomme Oliver pour le remplacer. Ayant accepté cette promotion, il ne peut pas former Duncan, la nouvelle recrue.

programme.title: Les recrues de la 15e
programme.desc: Lors d'une opération de saisie de biens, les différentes équipes du poste 15 sont confrontées à tout un tas de problèmes ; la saisie d'Andy et Nick dans une maison de paris illégaux mène à une confession louche.

programme.title: Les recrues de la 15e

programme.title: FBI: duo très spécial

programme.title: Cinéma

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: Quasifederal agents hunt a man (David Keith), who can bend minds, and his daughter (Drew Barrymore), who can start fires by staring.

programme.title: Beastly
programme.desc: After a spurned classmate curses him, a teen will be forever ugly unless he finds love.

programme.title: Furlough

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury
programme.desc: Desperate to meet women and open their own dance club, brainless brothers Steve (Will Ferrell) and Doug Butabi (Chris Kattan) cruise Beverly Hills.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: A murder in the Louvre Museum and clues in paintings by Leonardo da Vinci lead to the discovery of a religious mystery that could rock the foundations of Christianity.

programme.title: Planet Action
programme.desc: A look at how celebrities are stepping up to make a difference in the world and hopefully inspiring others to do the same.

programme.title: Thunderheart
programme.desc: When a series of murders stuns a Native American reservation, the FBI sends in agent Ray Levoi to investigate. While Ray is relatively inexperienced, he is one quarter Sioux and the FBI hopes that will make it easier for them to gather information.

programme.title: All the King's Men
programme.desc: A Southern politician's (Sean Penn) idealism and good intentions give way to corruption after he becomes governor of Louisiana.

programme.title: Revenge
programme.desc: Caught with the wife (Madeleine Stowe) of his Mexican host (Anthony Quinn), then left for dead, a former Navy jet pilot (Kevin Costner) recovers to take revenge.

programme.title: Truth or Consequences, N.M.
programme.desc: Police pursue a freed convict (Vincent Gallo) and his cohorts (Mykelti Williamson, Kiefer Sutherland) for robbery, drug trafficking and kidnapping.

programme.title: Anaconda 3: Offspring
programme.desc: A mercenary-for-hire accepts a mission from a billionaire to capture a dangerous snake that could possibly help cure a terminal illness.

programme.title: The Shepherd
programme.desc: A border-patrol agent (Jean-Claude Van Damme) must stop renegade Special Forces soldiers from smuggling heroin into the United States.

programme.title: Cleaner
programme.desc: A former lawman (Samuel L. Jackson) who cleans crime scenes becomes embroiled in a mystery involving a woman's (Eva Mendes) missing husband.

programme.title: 88 Minutes
programme.desc: A forensic psychiatrist (Al Pacino) must use all his skills and training to find the person who issued an ominous death threat.

programme.title: Linewatch
programme.desc: Border agent Michael Dixon's (Cuba Gooding Jr.) past as a gang member comes back to haunt him years later.

programme.title: Felon
programme.desc: A new convict (Stephen Dorff) struggles to maintain his sanity and sense of humanity after he's thrust into a prison system in which a brutal guard (Harold Perrineau) encourages gladiatorial combat between inmates.
